probeSources.runComparisonScript:
import os,json,pathlib,subprocess,time
w=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
env=os.environ.copy();env.update(QT_QPA_PLATFORM="offscreen",QT_HASH_SEED="0")
results=[]
for pair,order in enumerate([["baseline","current"],["current","baseline"],["baseline","current"]],1):
 for generation in order:
  out=w/f"{generation}-run-{pair}.json"
  args=[str(w/f"{generation}-probe"),str(w/"workload/Avid MediaFiles"),str(w/"workload/8645 v1.avb"),str(out)]
  start=time.monotonic()
  p=subprocess.run(args,env=env,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True,timeout=90)
  (w/f"{generation}-run-{pair}.log").write_text(p.stdout)
  item={"pair":pair,"generation":generation,"command":args,"exitCode":p.returncode,"wallSeconds":time.monotonic()-start,"output":str(out)}
  results.append(item);(w/"run-commands.json").write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+"\n")
  if p.returncode:
   print(json.dumps(item),flush=True);print(p.stdout[-3000:],flush=True);raise SystemExit(p.returncode)
  r=json.loads(out.read_text())
  print(json.dumps({"pair":pair,"generation":generation,"stages":[{k:s[k] for k in ["stage","elapsedMs","rows","lifetimePeakPhysicalFootprintBytes"] if k in s} for s in r["stages"]],"totalPhysicalBytes":r.get("totalPhysicalBytes"),"headerOutcomes":r.get("headerOutcomeCounts")}),flush=True)

limits: 267 complete local media files and one large bin for timing; no 300,000-file Windows/NEXIS acceptance.
Three fresh-process warm/uncontrolled-cache repeats establish bounded local observations, not a general performance guarantee.
Offscreen/UiOnly comparable phases exclude normal startup recovery/discovery, production disk-log installation and native input latency.
Native check uses Cocoa rendering, UiOnly startup, actual bin/export actions, isolated diagnostic log and Qt widget save picker; no Apple native save panel or manual input-latency measurement.
Historical workload names/content exactly reproduced; copy creation times/path and OS differ from 12 October. Same-day old-code rerun controls these conditions.
Large timed bin matches zero inventory rows; separate genuine small-bin native check validates one positive match/export.
CSV schema intentionally changed; retained shared fields plus renamed FileMobId compared by physical path. No inferred Source Path normalization was added.
Loaded-bin current memory is a post-load sample, not peak; full temporary bin parse still dominates cumulative lifetime peak.
New rows have no scan-session owner; old weak-pointer lifetime test is inapplicable to them. Compact ownership regression suites pass.
No exact-sequence/camera/timing work or new media-format support undertaken.
